question: A man covered a distance of 32 km. After 1 hour 20 minutes he noticed that the distance he covered is(5)/(7)th of the remaining distance. What was his speed in km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Ratio** of **Covered Distance** to **Remaining Distance** = 5 : 7

Total units = 5 + 7 = 12 units → 32 km

**Covered Distance** = (5 ÷ 12) × 32 = 40/3 km

**Time** = 1 hr 20 min = 4/3 hours

**Speed** = (40/3) ÷ (4/3) = 10 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 10 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Total Distance** = 32 km

**Time** = 1 hour 20 minutes

**Ratio condition:** Covered = (5/7) × Remaining

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3de194766e24c5a9201eaa583e35d70165928d13a6436dac91ed31ea20bb2f7d.png] 

Let the **Remaining Distance** be x km.

⇒ **Covered Distance** = (5/7)x

⇒ Total Distance = (5/7)x + x = 32

⇒ (12/7)x = 32

⇒ x = (32 × 7) ÷ 12 = 56/3 km

⇒ **Covered Distance** = 32 − 56/3 = (96 − 56) ÷ 3 = 40/3 km

⇒ **Time** in hours = 1 + 20/60 = 1 + 1/3 = 4/3 hours

⇒ **Speed** = (40/3) ÷ (4/3) = 10 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 10 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed, Distance, and Time Formula

The basic relationship is **Speed = Distance ÷ Time**. Ensure all units are consistent (e.g., km and hours).

Unit Conversion

To convert minutes to hours, **divide by 60**. To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18.

Ratio and Proportion in Distance

If distance is divided in ratio a:b, the first part is [a/(a+b)] × Total and the second part is [b/(a+b)] × Total.

Average Speed

**Average Speed** = Total Distance Traveled ÷ Total Time Taken. For two equal distances at speeds x and y, it is 2xy/(x+y).</p
